purpose: Classify the installed Windows fleet authority and optional CMD compatibility-shim boundary without duplicating current GNHF setup, adapter readiness, provider verification, or launcher ownership.

installedAuthority.rule: state.json plus Start-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 are the installed readiness authority. The CMD shim is optional compatibility and must not become a prerequisite for core readiness.

classifications.condition: exactly one of state.json or Start-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 exists
installed authority exists AND agent-switchboard.cmd is missing OR observed shim execution is Access is denied / exit 5
installed authority exists and no blocked-shim evidence is supplied

powerShellReadinessRoute.rule: The boundary classifier does not promote adapter/provider readiness. Execute the installed PowerShell operator and then consume the current startup-readiness reporter.

explicitlySuperseded: historical stale-repository-path classification: now owned by current machine-profile operational path/trap contracts
historical shell-command-mismatch classification: now owned by current operational shell/path contracts
historical core-ready-hermes-deferred workflow: current GNHF setup and Hermes contracts already own SkipHermesInstall/graceful blocking
historical adapter-ready-provider-unproved classification: current Get-AgentSwitchboardStartupReport.ps1 owns local adapter/provider-proof separation
historical task pickup/handoff launch lifecycle: current launchers and execution-adapter owners remain canonical
historical pre-push hook and experimental fleet-readiness skill: not revived by this leaf
proofCeiling: Tracked contract, synthetic classification, read-only file-presence observation, and supplied shim-result classification only. No workstation readiness, adapter readiness, provider authentication, hosted response, repository delivery, or runtime task completion is proven.
